The Collection

Music·Podcasts

A monthly archive — 2016 to present

Since 2016 I've been making a playlist most months — more or less. Each one is built from the tunes I discover over the weeks: they catch my mood at the time, they follow my taste, and they bring back memories. It's my own journal, really. I hope you enjoy it.

Shows worth the hours — in no particular order
